outcome: perinatal outcomes (low birth weight, neonatal intensive care unit admissions)

maternal outcomes (cesarean section rate, blood transfusions during pregnancy and postpartum, hospital admission for acute painful crises, preeclampsia, maternal age, BMI, gravida, parity, MCV, MCH, RBC, Hb, Hct values)
cohort: The study included 26 pregnant women with homozygous mutated SCA and 108 pregnant women without the mutation who gave birth in the study's center.
finding: Pregnant women with homozygous SCA had significantly higher rates of low birth weight, neonatal intensive care unit admissions, and cesarean sections compared to those without the mutation, indicating serious risks for mother and fetus.
mod_finding: A higher cesarean section rate was observed in the group of pregnant women with homozygous SCA.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was an observed outcome, but specific weights of the babies included are not mentioned.
